VPL_converged.rule: converged rule: routed correct > best single correct (best of lineage constituents and exact_single, chosen on held-out results), routed wrong <= best single wrong, one-sided exact sign test p < 0.05 over discordant items, routed median latency <= 60 s. Lineage rule (constituents only) reported beside it.
